tasks.short: Install machinery safety devices or direct their installation.

steps.what: Locate current machinery drawings, safety-device instructions and site isolation requirements
inputs: actual machine identity and intended safety device
current controlled drawings and installation instructions

steps.what: Inspect actual machine hazards and determine safe device placement and installation method
inputs: actual machine condition and site hazards
outputs: chosen safe installation method and required isolation conditions

steps.what: Install safety devices or direct actual installation under established site safety controls
inputs: chosen safe installation method and required isolation conditions
actual authorised isolation and installation work conditions

steps.what: Perform actual installation checks and verify safety-device response against the chosen requirements
inputs: chosen safe installation method and required isolation conditions
outputs: actual installation test results and unresolved defects

steps.what: Write and check actual installation and test record in maintenance history
inputs: actual installation test results and unresolved defects

tasks.design: Configure machine-identity links from maintenance {OPS_SYSTEM} to controlled installation instructions in {DOCS}. Keep actual site inspection, installation or direction, physical testing and the complete maintenance record unchanged; this does not authorise machine restart or replace site isolation controls.
tasks.previous_blocker: Engineers may navigate several folders to find the current device drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset-to-document links can remove repeated path navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Device placement, isolation and real safety response depend on the actual machine.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer notices a physical bypass path absent from the drawing.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in document locating; physical responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked controlled documents can shorten locating machinery instructions; installation and safety verification stay physical expert work.

assumptions: Provisional focal engineer workflow, including only the engineer's hands-on installation or direction time, not installer crew labour. Two of10 source points are repeated folder navigation; eight remain for source selection and reading. Existing native linking earns no saving.

Maintenance and document owners supply actual asset id, device model, drawing revision, effective status and access-controlled link. Missing or contradictory revisions require manual owner confirmation. Engineer records actual test method, result, date and defects after installation; no pass inferred from a work order.

Actual isolation permits are produced by the site's existing authorised process before s3 and remain required. This boundary neither creates nor automates that external role's permit work, nor any return-to-service decision. Internal maintenance record writing and its save are retained together without self-approval or saving; add no invented report or send.
unknowns: Does this engineer own installation records or only direct installers?
research_questions: Can asset links eliminate folder navigation while preserving revision checks at the machine?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 repeated folder-navigation points minus0.3 upkeep=1.7. Low: an unusual retrofit still needs manual drawing searches, but the linked machine identity removes0.5 locating points, minus0.3=0.2. Inspection, installation/direction, tests and actual record writing retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Slightly less document navigation around unchanged safety-engineering work.
role.ambitious_version: Current installation sources available at the asset while people retain installation and safety decisions.

job.title: Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors
